gen-archivo-black-gf-halant: Halant, a text serif with a faint thick-thin shift and outward-pointing terminals, takes over from a heading in Archivo Black that fills its lines. Archivo Black hits hard; Halant settles in.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sanchez: Oswald packs its letters into tightly knit rows with real muscle. Sanchez, a text serif with calipers-wide c shapes, makes a longer stretch feel bookish and dignified.
gen-almendra-display-gf-chocolate-classi: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never pinch shut, and Chocolate Classical Sans follows with a sizable lowercase and broad-nibbed strokes. One decorates; the other simply gets on with talking.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-solway: Solway, a text serif with a bookish, authoritative streak, keeps its line weight flat like stencil work. Solway also has bowls as heavy as its stems, so a slightly larger size lets that sturdiness show, while Oswald stays tight and confident above it.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-chillax: Chillax reads loose and casual, its lines like spaghetti and its curves left unfinished where the pen lifts. And Red Hat Display, drawn with marker-like constancy and daylight inside every curve, gives a long page a bold, contemporary spine.
gen-almendra-display-gf-comme: Ornate letters that never pinch shut lead the way here. Almendra Display is literary and decorative, while Comme, a plain sans with lowercase bodies filling most of the height, just reads smoothly and modern.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-yuji-boku: Dignified and editorial, this pairing has weight at both ends. Oswald is confident and tightly packed, while Yuji Boku, a text serif with cable-like strokes and a bracelet-wide c, is the one that keeps going.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cossette-texte: Cossette Texte reads clean and wide-eyed, with a prominent x-height. Under Almendra Display's ornate, literary heading, a longer stretch of it would move along smoothly, its n arches as thick as the stems.
gen-orbitron-fs-paquito: Precise and minimal, Orbitron spreads its letters along the line with big, clear eyes on every e, while Paquito is confident and approachable. Orbitron is built for cool precision; Paquito, for warmth.
gen-almendra-display-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans keeps a modern, clean look, with wide openings on small letters and bodies that dominate the line. Almendra Display adds ornate, literary flourish; Duru Sans keeps things tidy.
